# Real data snapshots

`2026-10-18-before-v1.0.1.json` — rows of the owner's Google Sheet read on 18.10.2026 before the
v1.0.1 correction (Google Sheets connector, read-only): the 18.10.2026 workout from `App_Sessions`,
all of its sets from `App_Sets` and day 2 of `App_Program`, exactly as stored (sheet values, header
row first). It is the backup of what the correction changes and the input of
`tests/unit/fix-2026-10-18.test.js` and `tests/e2e/fix-2026-10-18.spec.js`. Don't edit.
